title: Princess 75 Motor Yacht
highlights: Walnut interior, Poltrona Frau dining chairs
description:
This 2017 Princess 75 Motor Yacht is lying in Phuket, Thailand. She is powered by twin Caterpillar C32A engines of 1,723 HP each and fitted with both Seakeeper 16 and Seakeeper 9 gyro stabilisers for comfort at sea and at anchor.

Her walnut interior is complemented by Poltrona Frau dining chairs, a GRP flybridge hardtop, hydraulic bow and stern thrusters and a fourth control station.
